verdicts.title: Distributed Formal Concept Analysis Algorithms Based on an Iterative MapReduce Framework
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: While many existing formal concept analysis algorithms are efficient, they are typically unsuitable for distributed implementation. Taking the MapReduce (MR) framework as our inspiration we introduce a distributed approach for performing formal concept mining.
